source_purpose: canonical future presentation contract, independent of saved gameplay schema

metadata.session_generation: positive integer; session-local, not a save identity
metadata.speaker_player_id: 1..8; player slot, never a lord identity
metadata.speaker_lord_id: positive native GetAILord snapshot or null; no inferred identity
metadata.reason: semantic cause, no translated text or media filename

reference.kind: submission_offer | fealty | tribute_cycle; future contracts may add kinds
reference.started_day: nonnegative integer or null when unavailable
reference.sequence: nonnegative integer or null; paid cycle counter for tribute
reference.good_id: nonnegative integer or null; copied game good identifier
reference.due_day: nonnegative integer or null; next due day for a paid cycle

alliance.offered.future_commit: new offer creation, not ShowNextPendingOffer or load presentation

alliance.formed.future_commit: successful team journal commit, dispatched after all outer native leases

alliance.broken.future_commit: successful break journal commit, dispatched after all outer native leases

truce.formed.future_commit: TruceFormed resolution; distinguish live transfer from save_journal replay

trade_pact.formed.future_commit: TradePactFormed resolution; distinguish live transfer from save_journal replay

support.requested.future_commit: new support demand committed, not repeated presentation

support.fulfilled.future_commit: completed live transfer bookkeeping with SupportFulfilled resolution

ultimatum.issued.future_commit: new ultimatum committed, not repeated presentation

ultimatum.fulfilled.future_commit: completed live transfer bookkeeping with UltimatumFulfilled resolution

submission.offered.identity: player/lord captured by existing eligibility check

submission.declined.reference: quoted tribute; original offer day unavailable after CloseOffer and explicitly null

fealty.established.future_commit: successful submission team commit or accepted human fealty; dispatch after all leases

fealty.released.reference: fealty, historical amount/day intentionally absent after release

equality.requested.future_commit: new equality request persisted; exclude restored request popup

equality.granted.reference: fealty, historical amount/day intentionally absent after release

equality.refused.future_commit: accepted rejection decision; separate from subsequent rebellion team commit

tribute.paid.identity: AI payer, or AI recipient when local player pays; lord unknown
tribute.paid.reference: payer, recipient, amount, good, completed cycle count and next due day

tribute.defaulted.future_commit: RegisterMiss commits an actual missed cycle; technical transfer failure excluded

restitution.accepted.future_commit: completed live bookkeeping with RestitutionAccepted; save_journal replay excluded
